title: Wittington Investments to Acquire Boots in $8.9 Billion Deal
summary: The Weston family's Wittington Investments, in partnership with Fairfax, will take control of the British retailer, with plans to invest in store upgrades, online enhancements and expanded health care services.

extraction.key_fact: 위팅턴 인베스트먼츠가 페어팩스와 협력하여 영국 소매 유통업체 부츠를 인수하기로 합의했다.
